Pay from UK delivery to Poland

We control the ship-out (within 5 business days), not the delivery day. Best play: order so it ships just before you travel, then use the carrier's tracking to rebook the delivery date once it's moving.

21october

Order around 9–13 October: it ships within 5 business days and arrives while you're in Poland, with tracking to fine-tune the day.

I won't guess transit days — that's the carrier's, and customs clearance can add to it. Checkout shows the service options for your Polish address, and that's where the realistic estimate appears.

What I can promise is the ship-out: within 5 business days of the order.
Where is it shipped from?

From our warehouse — we hold BC04 stock in the US, Canada and the EU, and the one that serves your address fulfils it.

Which one covers a Polish delivery decides your VAT: from the EU warehouse it's included, from the US it's the 21% on delivery I mentioned. I'd rather confirm that than have you guess.

Georges has it. The team picks it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email — which warehouse ships it, and whether the 21% is on delivery or already in the price.

That still fits your 9–13 October ordering window comfortably.
Ok.can I have all info about it please? With approx best time to click "buy now" to have delivered 21october+ few days please

Here's the whole picture on the Hammer Miner BC04.

Spec: ~6 TH/s SHA-256, ~100W, fan and heatsink cooling, ~50 dB, WiFi 2.4 GHz plus wired ethernet. In the box: the miner, a 120W power supply and a power cord, with the plug matched to your delivery address — Poland gets EU type C/F.

Price: $239. Shipping to Poland starts at $21.99, exact figure at checkout. Then the tax question Georges is confirming for you: 21% import VAT either already in the price (EU warehouse) or collected by the carrier on delivery (US warehouse).

Timing: it's in stock and ships within 5 business days of the order. For a delivery on or just after 21 October, click buy around 9–13 October. Order 9 October and it's shipped by the 16th at the latest; order the 13th and it's shipped by the 20th. Transit and customs sit on top, which is why I won't pin a delivery day — but that window puts the parcel in Poland while you're there, and the carrier's tracking lets you rebook the exact day once it's moving.

One honest caveat: stock is a live pool, so I can't hold one for you. If the bar on the page gets low before the 9th, order earlier and deal with the delivery date through the carrier instead.
